main_text.l: Cap.5. De artium magicarum origine & occasionibus. 289

page.notes: The page-number "289" printed under the Cap.5 line and "297" under item 7 are set on their own line; I have read them as belonging to the entry above. The "i." before "fedus" in "Hinc est" is read as the numeral 1 and is marked [?]. "Quòd" keeps its printed grave accent. Long s is read as s throughout ("salutaria", "sagarum", "secundi"). The diagram brace groups six entries under the label. The neighbouring page's edge at the right and the digitiser's banner are left out.
